execution.editing: Accepted edit-only hosted worker or explicitly active external producer.

preconditions: Plan adopted for any new automatic authority
Current live ownership snapshot available for potentially conflicting work
No unresolved prerequisite or applicable human/external gate
One bounded governing issue and exact path scope
order: Observe active owned work before selecting anything new
Repair concrete correctness/safety blockers on the critical path
Finish existing bounded milestone without widening it
Select eligible node by priority, then stable node ID
Use already-authorized disjoint work when primary path waits
constraints: One governing issue owner; two producers only if scopes and semantic dependencies are independent and controller permits it
Milestones/expansions must decompose; no broad dispatch
No repeated CI polling; resume on material events
No rebase merely for behind count
No expensive rerun without changed risk/dependency surface
No machine completion from merge/issue closure alone

completion_record_contract.rule: All applicable criteria must PASS with attributable evidence; any required human criterion needs explicit scoped owner verdict. A changed dependency surface requires requalification or documented evidence portability.

failure_policy.ci: Classify compilation, deterministic regression, environment or flaky scheduling. Repair only affected scope; no rerun of unchanged failure without a stated diagnostic hypothesis.
failure_policy.human: Record CHANGES_REQUIRED against exact artifact; reopen only affected nodes and material-delta criteria. Never auto-submit identical artifact.
failure_policy.authority: Hold the conflicting task; continue disjoint eligible work. Do not retire unknown active claims.
failure_policy.no_progress: After two attempts with the same failure cause and no information gain, stop extending scope and request a bounded diagnosis/review. Session restart still requires applicable owner authorization.
failure_policy.scope: New product semantics, numeric product budgets, permissions or destructive change go to director at their actual trigger.
